+

+
+        {% ctrans use_i18n, count=items|length trimmed %}
+            One item
+        {% pluralize %}
+            {{ count }} items
+        {% fallback %}
+            {{ count }} item(s)
+        {% endctrans %}

+    mandatory ``fallback`` section is rendered as it is, with the same
